categories.main_business_segments: Jinhong Gas Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the industrial gas sector, focusing on the research, production, sales, and integrated service solutions of gases. Its main product categories include specialty gases, bulk gases, and fuel gases, serving industries such as electronics semiconductor, medical health, energy conservation, new materials, new energy, and high-end equipment manufacturing. The company also provides comprehensive gas management services including Total Gas and Chemical Management (TGCM).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as air separation, chemical synthesis, physical purification, gas filling, and gas mixing. It has developed proprietary technologies in gas purification, tail gas recovery and purification, cryogenic continuous supply, high-purity gas packaging treatment, and safe and efficient logistics. Jinhong Gas holds numerous patents and has established a robust R&D system focusing on high-purity and ultra-pure gases critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading companies in the semiconductor, photovoltaic, LED, fiber optic communication, medical health, and new energy sectors. Major clients include well-known semiconductor manufacturers like SMIC, Hynix, and others, as well as photovoltaic companies such as Tongwei and Trina Solar. The company serves both end-users and gas companies, providing tailored gas solutions and integrated services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Jinhong Gas has a strong presence in China, especially in the Yangtze River Delta region, with expanding operations in other key economic zones such as the Pearl River Delta, Beijing-Tianjin, and Sichuan-Chongqing areas. It has also established overseas operations, including a production base in Vietnam and investment in Singapore, exporting products to over 30 countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial gas supply chain. It produces gases through proprietary manufacturing and purification processes and supplies them directly to end customers or through gas companies. It also engages in logistics and distribution, including onsite gas production and pipeline supply services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Jinhong Gas emphasizes vertical development through continuous innovation in specialty gases, especially electronic gases for semiconductor applications, aiming to replace imports and break foreign monopolies. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on high-purity gases and new materials, and collaborates with universities and research institutes. The company also pursues horizontal expansion via cross-regional market integration and overseas market development, alongside digital transformation and green manufacturing initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue mainly through the sale of industrial gases in various forms including bottled gases, bulk supply via storage tanks, and onsite gas production. It also earns income from comprehensive gas management services (TGCM), equipment sales, and logistics services. Revenue is derived from contracts with end customers and gas companies, with pricing based on product specifications, volume, and service agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jinhong Gas is a leading domestic player in China's industrial gas market, ranking first among private gas companies in sales for three consecutive years. It competes with global industrial gas giants such as Linde, Air Liquide, Air Products, and Taiyo Nippon Sanso, which dominate the high-end specialty gas market. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, localized service, and expanding market coverage, aiming to increase its market share and challenge foreign dominance in specialty gases.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Jinhong Gas reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.43 billion, a 23.4% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 315 million, up 37.48%. Total assets reached RMB 6.24 billion, growing 31.79% from the previous year, supported by capital raised through convertible bonds. The company maintains a healthy growth trajectory with increasing profitability and expanding operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinhong Gas offers a comprehensive range of over 100 gas products with high purity and quality standards, many of which have replaced imported specialty gases. Its value proposition lies in integrated gas supply solutions tailored to high-tech industries, combining product quality, reliable supply, advanced technology, and customized services such as TGCM. The company emphasizes environmental sustainability, digital transformation, and strong customer relationships to differentiate itself in a competitive market.
